hospital_course.value: Patient presented to us with above mentioned complaints. After evaluation, she was admitted to ward. Initial investigations showed normal CBC, Serum creatinine (1.64me/dl) done was elevated. Serum electrolytes done showed low serum sodium( 128.00mnol/L). Urine routine done showed ketone bodies(+), 10-l2/hpf of pus cells, 13-20/hpf of epithelial cells with presence of bactreia hence urine culture and sensitivity sent- report awaited. She was treated with IV fluids, Patient received IV antibiotics, IV PPI's, IV antiemetics and other supportive measures. USG abdomen and pelvis done showed Grade-I fatty liver changes and mildly edematous part of ascending colon upto the hepatic flexure- could represent colitis. Repeat Serum Creatinine(1.17 mg/dl) done was normal. TSH and Free T4 done were normal. Stool routine done showed 2-4/hpf of red blood cells, plenty/hpf of pus cells. Patient was adviced to stay back for further management but attenders not willing to the same, hence being discharged at request.
